{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue'] == 999999.99
sales = sales[~qa_mask]

# Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
refunded_mask = sales['status'] == 'refunded'
sales = sales[~refunded_mask]

# Replace -1 in customer_age with NaN
sales['customer_age'] = sales['customer_age'].replace(-1, pd.NA)

# Confirm the cleanup
print(f"Original rows: {len(pd.read_csv(file_path))}")
print(f"After removing QA and refunded: {len(sales)}")
print(f"QA orders removed: {qa_mask.sum()}")
print(f"Refunded orders removed: {refunded_mask.sum()}")
print(f"Missing age (replaced with NaN): {sales['customer_age'].isna().sum()}")

# Check channel distribution
print("\nChannel distribution:")
print(sales['channel'].value_counts())

# Check customer_segment distribution
print("\nCustomer segment distribution:")
print(sales['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check if converted is binary
print("\nConverted distribution:")
print(sales['converted'].value_counts())"}
